term: reflexive nontransitive chain and one-step reachability
definition: chain explicitly lists root, middle and endpoint. Each accesses itself; root also accesses middle; middle also accesses endpoint; there is no root-to-endpoint edge or reverse cross-edge. The independent atom is true exactly at endpoint. chainLanguage is the denotation domain of Formula Unit under this same valuation. One diamond quantifies over one edge, not the transitive closure: root has possible possible full MC but no possible full MC.
